name: Essential Announcement Bar
summary: Shopify announcement bar app for static, rotating and scrolling top, bottom and cart-page bars with links, icons, scheduling, geo-targeting and translations; priced on how many times the bars load each month.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want a free, no-code top bar or rotating bar for shipping terms, offers and store notices, and who will pay $9.99 once they need scheduled flash-sale bars, cart-page bars or country targeting
skip_if: you want the scrolling marquee bar for free, because it starts on the $6.99 plan; your bar will load tens of thousands of times a month and nobody watches the app's email, because at the limit the bars are unpublished and do not come back on their own; or your theme already has an announcement bar that does what you need
honest_knock:
The bar the listing leads with is not on the free plan. The App Store copy opens on scrolling, marquee-style announcement bars, but the vendor's own help article on bar types says running-line announcements require a paid plan, and the pricing table puts them on Starter at $6.99. What the free plan does give you is a static bar and a rotating bar that cycles several messages; one merchant who installed it expecting the moving bar for free left a one-line complaint within half an hour. Scheduling, the feature that lets a flash-sale bar switch itself on and off, and the cart-page bar both start one step higher, on Essential at $9.99.

The view allowance is counted the expensive way. The help centre says a view is every render of a bar: each page load, each reload, and each bar when you run more than one on a page. A top bar sits on every page, so the free plan's 2,000 views is a few hundred browsing sessions a month on a small store, not 2,000 shoppers.

Running out does not cost money, it takes the bar down, and it stays down. Past the limit you get an email; three days later every published bar is unpublished, and the same article says that when views reset on the 1st the bars are not published again automatically. A store that misses the email loses its announcement for the rest of the month and then keeps missing it until someone notices and republishes.

The support that most reviews praise has one account on the other side. In April 2026 a UK merchant with twelve months on the app wrote that the team had published a page on her site without her consent and made styling changes that broke two sales pages shortly before a launch. Essential Apps replied that it was sorry and had only intended to help. If you give support access to fix a placement, say exactly what they may change. We have not installed the app.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-29 on apps.shopify.com/essential-announcement-bar, on essential-apps.com/announcement-bar and in the vendor's help articles on bar types and on views) Four plans priced on monthly bar views. Free covers up to 2,000 views a month with unlimited simple bars and unlimited rotating bars, each with a link or button. Starter is $6.99 a month, or $67.08 a year at a stated 20% saving, for up to 20,000 views, and adds running-line (scrolling marquee) bars and icons, including your own uploaded icons. Essential is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year for up to 50,000 views, and adds cart-page bars, scheduling, geolocation targeting and translations. Professional is $29.99 a month or $287.88 a year for unlimited views and every premium feature. Paid plans carry a 7-day free trial. A view is counted every time a bar is rendered: per page load, not per visitor, and two bars on one page count twice. There is no overage charge: past the limit you get an email, and if you do not upgrade within 3 days your bars are unpublished; views reset on the 1st of the month, but the help centre says the bars are not published again automatically. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Essential Apps, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 9 August 2023 and shows 1,302 reviews.

compare_with.name: Essential Countdown Timer Bar
compare_with.why: The comparison sits inside one developer. Essential Apps also publishes Essential Countdown Timer Bar, which puts a countdown in a top bar, on product pages, carts and emails. On our reading of 28 September 2026 it used the same price points - $6.99, $9.99 and $29.99 - but gave half the views on the lower plans: 1,000 free and 10,000 on Starter against 2,000 and 20,000 here, with 50,000 on the $9.99 tier in both. Both apps unpublish their widgets three days after you pass the limit. The choice is about the message. A sale with a real end date is what the countdown app is for; shipping terms, store notices and several rotating offers are what this app is for, and it lets you show them twice as often before you pay.
